title: Quickly-Crisp Kenyan Ground-Ginger-Lamb-Mixture Stew
description: A comforting Kenyan stew featuring ground ginger, deglazed for a crisp finish. This recipe is nut-free-friendly and perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: lamb shoulder, ground
ingredients.notes: Make sure to get it fresh

instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat for 2 minutes. Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and sauté for another minute, until fragrant.
Add the lamb and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chili flakes, curry powder, salt, and pepper. Stir well to combine.
Add the tomato paste and stir to combine. Cook for 2 minutes.
Add the coconut milk and water. Stir well to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the ground ginger and stir well to combine.
Stir in the ground coriander, if using.
Deglaze the pan with a tablespoon of water and simmer for another 2 minutes, until the mixture has thickened slightly.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro, if desired.
